description: For one home in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul area: the county's estimated market value, what recorded sales of similar nearby homes say it is worth, the gap between them, whether an appeal looks worth filing, the yearly tax a cut would save, and the county's appeal steps and 2027 dates. Use for 'is my property tax assessment too high', 'should I appeal my property value', 'my assessment went up, is it fair', 'what is my house assessed at vs what it would sell for'. Covers houses and townhouses in Ramsey, Anoka, Dakota, Scott and Washington counties and the City of Minneapolis; any other address gets an honest 'not covered'. Pass the street address with its city or ZIP. If the user has a newer valuation notice, pass its estimated market value as value_on_notice. Returns a link that opens the comparison on appeal-draft.vercel.app already filled in for that home.

address.description: Street address, ideally with city and ZIP, e.g. '1852 Ashland Ave, Saint Paul, MN 55104'

city.description: City, if not in the address

value_on_notice.description: Optional: the estimated market value printed on the owner's newest valuation notice, used instead of the value on our roll

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP, if not in the address

name: check_property_assessment
title: Is my property tax assessment too high? Should I appeal? (Twin Cities, Minnesota)
